name: Climate Experimental (ProjectCog port, 512 sandbox)
description: Demonstrates the four climate-stack ports from ProjectCog: anisotropic ridge fBm (directional mountain chains), multiplicative peak erosion (weathered ridges), domain warp on T/H fields (organic latitude/wind bends), and equator-gradient biome-threshold bias. CALIBRATED FOR 512x512 BIOME LAB SANDBOX — the moisture sweep is scale-dependent, so MoisturePerSeaCell/LandDecay/ForestMoistureMin are tuned for short fetches. Target histogram: ~40% land, with Grassland/Forest/DenseForest/Desert all present plus polar Snow + equatorial Jungle. Compare in Biome Lab → tick Compare A|B → load 'Fullworld Grassland' in Slot B (visible as the no-climate-stack baseline).
